invariants_acknowledged: Shipped and merged: #1468 (the waiting.list query, the 'Waiting for reply' section on the dashboard's Upcoming Tasks card, and the 'Waiting for reply' segment on the leads list, merged 20/11/2026 00:09) and #1472 (the index the waiting reads use, merged 20/11 00:20; additive, Class A). Both are contained in production commit 57f74af53 (api and worker deployed 21/11/2026 07:26).

What the evidence shows: on 20/11 the Friday flow run got '404 GET /api/trpc/waiting.list' on the dashboard and the leads list (3 of 18 views). On 21/11 the run of the same 18 views, on a local production build of 57f74af53 calling the production API, had zero console errors and zero failed requests, so the deployed API now answers waiting.list.

What the evidence does NOT show: a waiting enquiry listed, in wait order with its wait time, on the dashboard or the leads list; the count matching the list; the phone layout of the card; or a reply removing the lead. The 21/11 dashboard and leads captures were viewed at full size: the dashboard's Upcoming Tasks card shows Follow-ups due (111) and no 'Waiting for reply' section, and the leads list shows no waiting segment above the fold. The section renders nothing when no one is waiting (WaitingForReplySection returns null for an empty list), so these captures are consistent with nobody waiting and prove nothing about the list itself.
PR #1468 states its own screens were 'not checked at 390px or 1440px; to be checked on production'. That check has not been recorded.
The captures are not committed because this repository is public (they show the owner and his data). They are held privately; their SHA-256 hashes are recorded in artifact_hashes.
